scene_type: 2D (top-down / nadir view onto a canal; motion in the water plane facing the camera)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 is completely black (mean gray 0); scene content from frame 1
pixel_axes: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.evidence: phase correlation of bridge band and building facade vs frame 5 at frames 1,100,200,210: shifts < 0.05 px
camera.view: looking straight down; no horizon; water, bridge deck and boat all approx. one depth (planar)

objects.name: boat
objects.description: small white/grey wooden rowboat (pointed at both ends, 3-4 dark seat/thwart openings), the only moving object
objects.visible_frames: 1-109 (full 1-76, bow under bridge 77-109), hidden under bridge 110-169, re-emerges 170-210 (stern hidden 170-202, full 203-210)
objects.reference_point: centre of the solid hull (midpoint of the two hull tips), columns cx, cy
objects.motion_summary_px: straight down the canal (+y), x constant at 631.3; cy = 5.496*frame + 273.8 (rms 0.65 px over all measured frames 2-210); i.e. ~5.50 px/frame = ~131.9 px/s, constant; no visible acceleration

size_px.hull_length_note: solid hull tip-to-tip, same before (168..401 at frame 1) and after the bridge (1312..1544 at frame 210)
size_px.length_incl_note: pre-bridge mask includes a faint ~16 px thin post at the upper (stern) tip; bbox height y0..y1 = 248-251 at frames 1-60; after the bridge the bbox height is 232
size_px.width_note: across the beam, 84-85 px in all full frames
size_px.axis_note: long axis tilted ~3.5 deg from image vertical (angle measured from +x, y down); orientation unchanged throughout

objects.name: bridge
objects.description: stone (cobblestone) footbridge crossing the canal across the full image width, slightly tilted (right end lower), white kerbs + green/orange railings on both edges
objects.extent_px: upper edge (railing line) y~778 at x=200, 810 at x=600, 834 at x=800, 874 at x=1000; lower edge y~1211 at x=200, 1258 at x=600, 1262 at x=800, 1309 at x=1000; tilt ~6.9 deg; width across bridge (perpendicular, railing to railing) ~437 px (vertical extent ~440-450 px); length = spans whole image width (1174 px, ends not visible)
objects.at_boat_column_x631: occludes y 807..1265 (boat bow disappears at y~807, stern reappears at y~1262)

objects.name: lamp_posts
objects.description: 4 dark street lamps on the bridge corners, each with a bracket arm (2 on upper/north railing, 2 on lower/south railing)
objects.reliability: +/-10 px, read off frame 42 by eye

objects.name: bollards
objects.description: small dark posts at the water edge of the bridge near the boat's path: one just above the upper railing (~[570,755]) and one just below the lower railing (~[545,1285])

objects.name: canal_water
objects.description: dark green water channel running top-to-bottom
objects.extent_px: upper part (above bridge) water from x~177 to x~1015-1047 (~840-870 px wide); lower part (below bridge) left bank slanted x~100 (y=1400) to x~220 (y=2000), right bank x~920-940 (~710-870 px wide)
objects.reliability: +/-15 px (bank edges irregular, walls in shadow)

objects.name: buildings
objects.description: building facades seen from above on both banks: pink building upper-left (x<170, y<760), cream/blue-shuttered upper-right (x>1010, y<800), green/teal lower-left (x<200, y>1290), cream with pink/blue shutters lower-right (x>910, y>1270); flower boxes and window shutters

events.event: boat start of motion (frames 1 and 2 show the same position; moves from frame 2->3 on)
boat bow tip reaches upper bridge edge (y~807), begins to be occluded
boat midpoint under bridge centre line (cy~1035 at x=631)
boat bow reappears below the bridge (y~1262)
events.note: first reliable partial mask; bow tip first emerges ~frame 166-168

events.event: boat fully visible again below bridge
video ends with boat still moving

no_events: no bounces, contacts, direction changes, rotations or speed changes observed
